run_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific execution instance (e.g., hash or CI job ID).

status.description: The outcome of the tuning run. Used for sorting successful runs from failed ones.

execution_time_seconds.description: Total duration of the pipeline execution in seconds; used for performance monitoring.

module_output.description: The exact filename of the resulting ZIP archive uploaded to Dropbox (e.g., 'run_001.zip').

error_log.description: Capture of standard error output or stack trace if status is 'failed'; null if successful.
